assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, our asset coverage ratio was 181.2%.

portfolioCompanies.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had investments in 342 portfolio companies with an aggregate cost of $2,500.4 million.

nonAccrualCostPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had 11 portfolio companies with investments on non-accrual, the aggregate fair value of which was $13.7 million, which comprised 0.6% of the total fair value of our portfolio, and the aggregate cost of which was $38.3 million, which comprised 1.5% of the total cost of our portfolio.

nonAccrualFvPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had 11 portfolio companies with investments on non-accrual, the aggregate fair value of which was $13.7 million, which comprised 0.6% of the total fair value of our portfolio, and the aggregate cost of which was $38.3 million, which comprised 1.5% of the total cost of our portfolio.
